exam.title: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations Apps Developer
exam.study_prerequisites: Professional Dynamics 365 finance and operations development experience with X++, Visual Studio/AOT, extension models, Azure DevOps, ALM/environments, reporting, data entities/APIs, Power Platform integration, role/XDS security, automated testing and evidence-based performance tuning.

objective_coverage.objective_group: Plan the architecture and solution design

review.notes: Every January 30, 2026 subobjective maps to an architecture/environment, metadata/code/data/report/integration/security artifact, lifecycle gate, test, performance signal, evidence, failure or recovery decision. Three scenarios, eight labs and 36 checks cover all seven domains. All 16 URLs are cataloged: 14 reachable, with O'Reilly and Udemy automation-blocked; none missing or broken. The guide records active exam metadata, free assessment, 43h02 timed official paths plus reporting, five-day course, MIT labs, UDE/PPAC/LCS/Implementation portal transitions and commercial-resource age boundaries.

findings.title: Stored summary is not full objective text
findings.evidence: Prior22 bullets condense89 published objectives on the same baseline.
findings.recommendation: Archive prior evidence and restore canonical extraction.
findings.resolution: Archive prior evidence and restore canonical extraction.

findings.title: LCS-only provisioning guidance is outdated for new affected customers
findings.evidence: February16 freeze has explicit workload/existing-project exceptions.
findings.recommendation: Replace vague verify-current banner with a scoped ownership explanation.
findings.resolution: Replace vague verify-current banner with a scoped ownership explanation.

findings.title: Migration is a one-way preview with workload exclusions
findings.evidence: Sandbox-first guidance and Commerce checker gap are explicit.
findings.recommendation: Add migration prerequisites and retain production-preview limitation.
findings.resolution: Add migration prerequisites and retain production-preview limitation.

findings.title: UDE is not the Power Platform Developer environment type
findings.evidence: It is a single-developer Sandbox with developer tooling.
findings.recommendation: Add environment type and performance-testing boundaries.
findings.resolution: Add environment type and performance-testing boundaries.

findings.title: CoC order cannot implement an ordering dependency
findings.evidence: Wrapper selection order is not guaranteed.
findings.recommendation: Add original210/220 counterexample and method-attribute distinctions.
findings.resolution: Add original210/220 counterexample and method-attribute distinctions.

findings.title: Selection and update require a shared transaction scope
findings.evidence: forUpdate and ttsLevel enforce distinct requirements.
findings.recommendation: Add same-scope and nested-commit failure examples.
findings.resolution: Add same-scope and nested-commit failure examples.

findings.title: XDS table policies do not automatically protect data entities
findings.evidence: Official entity security excludes XDS and separates integration modes.
findings.recommendation: Correct scenario and add independent entity access tests.
findings.resolution: Correct scenario and add independent entity access tests.

findings.title: A receipt alone does not make the effect idempotent
findings.evidence: Control number detects duplicates, not sequence or delivery order.
findings.recommendation: Add locally executed atomic receipt/effect model and external-side-effect boundary.
findings.resolution: Add locally executed atomic receipt/effect model and external-side-effect boundary.

findings.title: Batch OData API was conflated with OData request batching
findings.evidence: The named API requeues jobs through SetBatchJobToWaiting.
findings.recommendation: Teach job control separately from CRUD changesets and package imports.
findings.resolution: Teach job control separately from CRUD changesets and package imports.

findings.title: Batch envelope does not imply one atomic commit
findings.evidence: Each changeset is the atomic unit.

findings.title: Runtime child retry and SQL transient retry differ
findings.evidence: FAQ assigns ordinary failed-child retries to a static controller.
findings.recommendation: Use bounded controller recovery and preserve transient exception classification.
findings.resolution: Use bounded controller recovery and preserve transient exception classification.

findings.title: Accepted/partial package execution is not complete success
findings.evidence: Execution IDs/status/errors and supported server-side parallelism matter.
findings.recommendation: Add key/count reconciliation and reject unrestricted client parallel imports.
findings.resolution: Add key/count reconciliation and reject unrestricted client parallel imports.

findings.title: Fast bypass methods change behavior
findings.evidence: doUpdate bypasses table update logic, handlers and CoC.
findings.recommendation: Require correctness proof before query/call-count optimization.
findings.resolution: Require correctness proof before query/call-count optimization.

blog_intake.author: Lane Swenka
blog_intake.notes: Complete main Lane Swenka September 15, 2023 article read. Accept architecture worksheet; preview/trial/capacity/add-in details remain historical.

blog_intake.author: Richard Riley
blog_intake.notes: Main August 25 article read in this sequential Finance review context. Preserve September new-disclosure transition and planned November15 retirement; no roadmap RSS/CSV ingestion.

offline_checks: 34 assertions across executed SQLite receipt/replay/rollback/identity model, CoC arithmetic, XDS set intersection, performance/reconciliation and catalog counts.

limitations: No Finance/Power Platform tenant, migration, API, X++ compiler, deployment, database credential, bank/payment action, email, paid course or assessment execution.
Sequential SQLite receipt/effect example and local calculations do not prove X++ concurrency, distributed exactly-once delivery, performance, security or tenant behavior.
Long references read in selected sections; full version/region/security/feature matrices and linked procedures not exhaustively audited.

Runtime general retry wording is resolved for guide scope using the static-controller FAQ; broader running-state Batch OData wording is not adopted. Exact task/state eligibility still requires sandbox validation.
Udemy/OReilly direct fetches blocked; indexed provider metadata is separately recorded. Partner/practice shells and unsearched Pluralsight/Whizlabs catalogs remain limitations.
Same-context AI review; independent human review and live lab evidence remain pending.
